title: Ordinary comparison commutes with fixed scalar equivalences
statement: For every scheme X and commutative ring k in universe u+1, the explicit etale scalar equivalence [def-sfb-fixed-scalar-etale-model] followed by coefficient-model comparison pullback [def-pe-etale-constructible-module] is naturally isomorphic to original fixed-k comparison inverse image followed by the pro-etale scalar equivalence. This is a statement about sheaves, with no boundedness or constructibility assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem fixedScalar_ordinary_comparison (X : Scheme.{u})
    (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k] :
    Nonempty ((fixedScalarEtaleSheafEquivalence X k).functor ⋙
        ProEtale.constructibleComparisonPullback.{u, u} X k ≅
      ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k) X ⋙
        (fixedScalarProEtaleSheafEquivalence X k).functor)
